text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Race day. The runners feel immense 
pressure from Duramente, who displayed an 
astonishing finishing burst in the Satsuki 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Satono Crown burns with quiet 
resolve. She has finished all preparations 
to face her. Now, all that remains is to 
run for victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To seize the honor of "Derby Umamusume," 
she now challenges the "Monster" of her 
generation—!
